title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time around ECU and Greenville.

cards.title: Browse the Gray Gallery
cards.subtitle: Jenkins Fine Arts Center, ECU
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition in Jenkins Fine Arts Center, then check the gallery page before you go for holiday closures.
cards.short_summary: A free ECU gallery visit with changing art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU states that the Wellington B. Gray Gallery is free and open to all.
cards.source_title: The Wellington B. Gray Gallery | School of Art & Design | ECU
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed for university holidays according to ECU.

cards.title: See work in the Senior Gallery
cards.subtitle: Jenkins Fine Arts Center, ECU
cards.notes: Stop into the Burroughs Wellcome Senior Gallery while visiting Jenkins and use the Gray Gallery page to confirm the current display.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery stop inside ECU’s Jenkins Fine Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU lists the Burroughs Wellcome Senior Gallery with the free, open-to-all Gray Gallery spaces.
cards.source_title: The Wellington B. Gray Gallery | School of Art & Design | ECU
cards.access_notes: ECU lists Monday–Friday hours of 8 a.m.–5 p.m. and university-holiday closures for the galleries.

cards.entity_name: ECU Visiting Artists, Designers, and Scholars
cards.title: Attend a visiting artist talk
cards.subtitle: School of Art & Design, ECU
cards.notes: Check the School of Art & Design calendar for a visiting artist, designer, or scholar talk and arrive early enough to settle in.
cards.short_summary: School of Art & Design talks that are free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU says its Visiting Artists, Designers, and Scholars events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visiting Artists, Designers, and Scholars | School of Art & Design | ECU
cards.access_notes: Events vary by the School of Art & Design calendar; ECU identifies them as free and open to the public.

cards.title: Claim a Joyner study room
cards.subtitle: Joyner Library, ECU main campus
cards.notes: Reserve a small or group room for a conversation, game plan, or quiet work session; use it only within the room’s listed limits.
cards.short_summary: Bookable library rooms for small groups or solo work.
cards.evidence_claim: Joyner Library provides reservable small and group study rooms for patrons, with first-come use when unreserved.
cards.access_notes: Small rooms support 1–2 people; group rooms support 2–6 people. Reservation availability and eligibility apply.

cards.title: Browse a Joyner exhibition
cards.subtitle: Joyner Library, ECU main campus
cards.notes: Make a loop through Joyner’s changing displays of photographs, maps, rare books, artifacts, and community art before settling elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: Rotating exhibits drawn from ECU collections and community art.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU says Joyner Library hosts exhibitions and displays of historical documents, photographs, rare books, maps, artwork, and artifacts.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Joyner Library; check library access information before visiting.

cards.title: Walk the campus one-mile route
cards.subtitle: ECU main campus
cards.notes: Use ECU Recreation & Wellness’s Campus 1 Mile route PDF for an easy, self-paced loop with a friend between classes.
cards.short_summary: A mapped one-mile campus walk from ECU Recreation & Wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU Recreation & Wellness publishes a Campus 1 Mile walking route.
cards.source_title: Walking Routes | Campus Recreation & Wellness | ECU
cards.access_notes: This is a self-guided outdoor route; follow campus pedestrian rules and weather conditions.

cards.title: Take the North Rec walk/jog loop
cards.subtitle: North Recreational Complex, ECU
cards.notes: Download ECU’s North Rec Walk/Jog route, bring water, and use the marked route for a low-key outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A published ECU walk/jog route at North Rec.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU Recreation & Wellness lists a North Rec Walk/Jog route among its walking routes.
cards.source_title: Walking Routes | Campus Recreation & Wellness | ECU
cards.access_notes: This is a self-guided outdoor route; follow posted complex rules and use it during appropriate daylight conditions.

cards.title: Walk Town Common’s riverfront
cards.subtitle: 105 E. 1st St., Greenville
cards.notes: Meet by the Tar River esplanade, take the paved walkway, and pause at the benches or playground area without reserving a shelter.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront public park with greenway and paved walking space.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Greenville lists Town Common amenities including a greenway, walking trails, paved walkway, benches, and public restrooms.
cards.access_notes: Public park amenities are available without a shelter reservation; reservations apply only to reserved facilities.

cards.title: Visit the Greenville Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 802 South Evans St., Greenville
cards.notes: Browse the galleries on your own, and skip the paid guided tour if you want to keep the visit entirely free.
cards.short_summary: Free general admission to a Greenville art museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenville Museum of Art states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit GMOA | Greenville Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; the museum lists Tuesday–Saturday hours, 10 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Paid guided tours are optional.

cards.title: Stroll the Pitt County Arboretum
cards.subtitle: 403 Government Circle, Greenville
cards.notes: Take a self-guided walk through the garden collections, or register ahead for a scheduled plant walk when one fits your calendar.
cards.short_summary: A public garden with no admission charge and free parking.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pitt County Arboretum states that there is no admission charge and that parking is free.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | The Pitt County Arboretum
cards.access_notes: Open to the public seven days a week from dawn to dusk; seasonal detailed hours are listed by the arboretum.
